name: TGorillaVolumetricNoise
definition: A subclass of TGorillaVolumetricMesh that fills its own 3D texture with fractal (FBM) Perlin noise and renders it as a physically based emission-absorption medium.
summary: TGorillaVolumetricNoise is a procedural volume component that generates 3D noise textures for clouds or smoke, avoiding terracing artifacts by baking a smooth density gradient and applying opacity at render time.
